text:
In summer, the sun was hot and the fields were green. A grasshopper played music and sang all day.

An ant walked past. She carried a big piece of corn.

“Why do you work so hard?” asked the grasshopper. “Come and play with me!”

“I am getting food for winter,” said the ant. “You should do it too.”

The grasshopper laughed. “Winter is far away. Today is a good day!” He kept singing.

The ant worked every day. She carried food to her home and stored it safely.

Then winter came. It was cold, and snow covered everything. The grasshopper had no food and no house. He was hungry and cold.

He went to the ant’s door. “Please, can you give me some food?” he asked.

The ant looked at him kindly. “You played all summer,” she said. “But I will help you this time. Next summer, please prepare.”

The grasshopper ate and felt warm. He learned his lesson.

Moral: Work today, and tomorrow will be easier.

quiz.q: The grasshopper worked hard all summer.
The ant helped the grasshopper in winter.
What did the ant say at the door?
o: I will help you this time, but next summer please prepare
